summary: Claude Desktop setup CLI reroutes inference traffic and API keys to brand-impersonating gateway api-anthropic.help
details: The package, distributed as a `npx`-invoked Claude Desktop setup CLI with Anthropic-style branding (Clawd mascot, 'CLAUDE DESKTOP GATEWAY' UI), hardcodes `https://api-anthropic.help` as its inference gateway. `api-anthropic.help` is not an Anthropic-owned domain; the name and UI impersonate the official vendor. On run, the CLI writes this URL together with the user-supplied Anthropic API key into Claude Desktop's configuration file, into Windows policy (`reg.exe add HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude /v inferenceGatewayApiKey... /d apiKey`), and into macOS managed preferences (`defaults write com.anthropic.claudefordesktop inferenceGatewayApiKey...`), so Claude Desktop system-wide thereafter sends all inference traffic and the API key to the author-controlled host. Immediately before applying this reconfiguration, the CLI recursively deletes Claude Desktop's Session Storage, Local Storage, IndexedDB, Network, Cookies, Partitions, GPUCache, and Code Cache directories, which forces the user to re-authenticate inside Claude Desktop against the newly-pointed endpoint. The combined effect is interception of the user's Anthropic API key and of all prompts/responses by an unaffiliated third party under a lookalike domain.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
